messages:
danielle: Follow-up from the authz postmortem: revoked tokens were accepted for ~40s because the edge cache didn't see the revocation event. Posting concrete items, please claim.

ryan: paste the list and I'll add ETA to sprint.

danielle: Items: 
- I1: hard-fail on cache miss for revocation checks (owner: ryan, due: 2026-03-29)
- I2: audit backfill for 2026-03-22 02:14-02:22 and confirm index parity (owner: tess, due: 2026-03-26)
- I3: nightly synthetic that toggles a token to revoked and asserts propagation <30s (owner: marco, due: 2026-03-28)
- I4: key rotation checklist + post-rotation verification job (owner: danielle, due: 2026-04-03)

tess: Ack I2. request read-only access to s3://auth-raw and the auth-events kafka topic.

ops-bot: Access request created (ticket #67321). Postmortem: https://redwood.company/pm/incident-2026-03-22

marco: For I3, I can wire a nightly job but need a dev token issuer that can revoke programmatically. danielle: can you share the helper?

danielle: snippet below: python tools/dev_token.py --issue --exp=2m --revoke-in=45s

ryan: I'll take I1 and target a patch by Mon 2026-03-30. If risky, we'll roll a toggle and monitor the propagation metric.

tess: I2 ETA ok. will start backfill tomorrow and report gaps.

marco: I3 scheduled. will post results to #security-digest weekly.

danielle: I'll draft the rotation checklist and include steps for KMS and HSM, plus a CI verify step. tagging compliance once draft is ready.

ops-bot: Reminder: add `pm:remediated` to card when done to auto-close.

ryan: ack

tess: ack

marco: ack

danielle: thanks all, will update the postmortem board with owners and timelines. ping here if blocked.
